item.title: FRUKT
item.description:
Title: FRUKT
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: tripledose
Publisher: tripledose
Release Date: Sep 24, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 24, 2026




About This Game

FRUKT is a death sandbox where every kill becomes an experiment.

Kill, dismember, and torment highly detailed voxel-based humanoids. Every bone breaks, every muscle tears, every organ reacts to damage. No rules, no story - only death.

Key features:

  • Dynamic dismemberment : tear off limbs, slice everything into pieces - body is fully physical and voxel-based.

  • Functional organs : the heart pumps blood, the brain controls the body, muscles hold strength. Hit the heart and the ragdoll will bleed out. Destroy the brain and it dies instantly.

  • Physical balance : victims react naturally to all impacts, trying to stay on their feet and falling like real humans.

  • Realistic movement : every step depends on muscle strength and the surface below. Break the legs and watch them fail to hold the body.

Want to support development?

Add FRUKT to your Steam wishlist and don’t miss the release!

Want to share ideas and follow updates?

Join our Discord community!

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

AI coding assistants are used during the development of FRUKT. Every line of code is reviewed by me, and all design, architecture and creative decisions are mine. No AI-generated art, animation, or written content ships in the game.

The only other AI use is the music in the demo teaser trailer.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: TDA
    • Graphics: TDA
    • DirectX: Version 11
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: TDA
    • Graphics: TDA

item.title: Farming Camp
item.description:
Title: Farming Camp
Genre: Adventure , Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Innerfire Studios
Publisher: SOEDESCO
Release Date: Sep 24, 2026




About This Game

Farming Camp is a cozy, single-player farm management game that follows the journey of an ambitious teenager competing to become the best farmer in the camp. Manage your farm alongside your companions, complete chores for points, and deal with the dynamics of a colorful cast in their teenage years.

Your path to farming greatness begins!

Step into the boots of young Alessandra, before she became the renowned Evertree Farmer. Experience her life at the Evertree Farming Camp where it all began. Learn the ropes and face the fun and chaos of camp life.

Team up with a lively farming crew

You're not alone on the farm. You’ll have the company of two budding young farmers, each with their own vibe. Assign chores, solve problems, and build friendships as you figure out how to run the farm together.

Heart, humor, and harvests!

Farming’s only half the fun at Evertree Farming Camp. From delightful dramas to silly surprises, and even a few messy moments, there's never a dull day at the camp!

Work hard to take care of the camp

Use the tools at your disposal and climb your way to the top as the camp’s best farming team. Coordinate with your companions and earn points by completing chores, maintaining the camp, attending classes, and tackling missions.

Have fun and win the competition

Jump into quick and fun minigames that keep things exciting—whether it’s racing against the clock to eliminate pests, chopping wood, cooking delicious meals, and more!

Key Features

  • Embark on a cozy single-player farming adventure and follow a unique, captivating story.

  • Explore a beautifully hand-drawn 2D top-down world full of charming details.

  • Meet a diverse and lovable cast of characters, each with their own quirks, stories, and farming talents.

  • Grow a variety of crops, care for animals, fish, and make your team win the competition.

  • Keep your farm thriving with fun and engaging mini-games.

item.title: Dragon Shelter
item.description:
Title: Dragon Shelter
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Wild Forest Studio
Publisher: Curve Games
Release Date: Sep 24, 2026




About This Game

Join a heartfelt adventure where friendship, care, and hard work restore harmony to a forgotten world. Rebuild the lost bond between humans and dragons as you transform abandoned lands into a place filled with warmth and joy. Grow crops, gather resources, raise adorable dragons, and help townsfolk rediscover their happiness.

Befriend cheerful dragons, each with unique traits and special powers that assist you on the farm and beyond. Care for them with love and playtime, and they’ll become loyal companions who sense people’s needs and lend their magic wherever it’s needed.

Rebuild your grandpa’s abandoned farm into a thriving sanctuary. Grow crops, harvest resources, and craft valuable goods while your dragon helpers support every step. Watch the land come back to life as your care turns a forgotten place into a haven of joy.

Cooking is the heart of crafting in Dragon Shelter. Meals strengthen bonds with neighbors, lift spirits, and unlock new opportunities. Every harvest can be used in cooking, crafting, alchemy, or trade – making each recipe meaningful and rewarding.

A nearby town has fallen into gloom, but hope remains. With the help of your dragons, reconnect with the townsfolk, uncover their stories, and rekindle their sense of joy and community.

Venture into a vibrant fantasy world filled with magical biomes, curious creatures, and hidden secrets. Every journey offers delightful surprises and the chance to restore life to forgotten lands.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI is used only to assist with localization/translation. All localized text is reviewed and edited by the developer.

No AI-generated art, audio, or in-game live generation is used.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700 / AMD Ryzen 3200
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 10 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: 1080p @ 30 FPS on Low settings. SSD recommended
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 590 (6 GB VRAM)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 10 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: 1080p @ 60 FPS on High settings.

item.title: Mars Attracts
item.description:
Title: Mars Attracts
Genre: Action , Adventure , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Outlier
Publisher: Outlier
Franchise: Top Indie Developers
Release Date: Sep 24, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 15, 2025




About This Game

Guess Who's Ack, Ack Again...

Mars Attracts is a theme park management game set on Mars. Play as the devious Martians from the cult-classic universe of Mars Attacks™ and build your amusement park empire, abducting humans from across history to display in customizable enclosures for the entertainment of curious Martian guests. Study humanity in their natural habitat, or subject them to whatever twisted experiments you can imagine!

Business Is Boomin'!

Take on the role of a Martian CEO and confront the challenge of theme park management — craft the perfect red planet tourist attraction, complete with human enclosures, death-defying rides, and a carefully selected range of amenities. You won’t last long if you can’t turn a profit.

  • Cater to your guests’ diverse needs by unlocking a range of merch stalls, food vendors, and colorfully gruesome decorations.

  • Manage supply chains by assigning helpful porters to keep your park running smoothly.

  • Balance your books by taking out loans and customising prices with an in-depth financial management system.

  • Gain the approval of the colourful cast of Martian board members by completing optional missions and park inspections.

Improvise, Abduct, Overcome

Humans come in all shapes, sizes, and bounciness. Employ advanced Martian technology to procure humans from across history – from Ancient Rome to the Wild West – and build the perfect habitat to ensure they have no idea they ever left.

  • Launch abduction missions to Earth to capture humans from across history, each with their own set of unique traits and preferences.

  • Gather knowledge of humans from different time periods to learn how to construct the perfect enclosure.

  • Collect unique historical humans including Julius Caesar, Cleopatra, and Date Masamune.

  • Tailor enclosures to appeal to each human’s unique preferences using decor items collected from expeditions.

  • Unhappy humans won’t remain docile for long. Hire security teams and build defences to deal with rampaging humans before they trash your beautiful park and kill your innocent guests.

It's Probing Time!

For centuries, Martian explorers have scoured the galaxy for signs of intelligent life. So far, no luck. Nevertheless, there is much to be learned by studying human behavior. Maximize their happiness to enlighten your guests on the mysteries of these strange enclosed-brained creatures, or push your captives to the limit and see what breaks. For science, of course.

  • Unlock new buildings and staff abilities from the research tree by performing gruesome experiments on captive humans.

  • Dissect excess humans to construct anatomical horrors to decorate your park.

  • Satisfy your guests’ need for random acts of cruelty by building torture devices, running experiments, or selling merch made from human body parts.

Descrierea conținutului pentru adulți indisponibilă.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Storage: 3 GB available space
